comments.body:
3 Recipes:

"Augmented Bow Armour Howitzer" Casting 11, Sophia Rank 5, 1260 Sophia

"Augmented Stern Armour Howitzer" Casting 11, Sophia Rank 5, 1260 Sophia
36 x Gunpowder + 48 x Cannon Shot + 60 x Steel
= Prototype Stern Armour Howitzer (normal success) / Deluxe Stern Armour Howitzer (great success)

"Augmented Armour Howitzer (20)" Casting 12, Sophia Rank 5, 1640 Sophia
120 x Gunpowder + 160 x Cannon Shot + 200 x Steel
= Prototype Armour Howitzer (20) (normal success) / Deluxe Armour Howitzer (20) (great success)
